How it works

How the film keeps rooms cool

The sun hits your glass

Big windows bring in light — and a lot of heat and UV with it.

Without film, rooms heat up

Heat pours in, the AC runs all day, and furniture slowly fades.

With Exotic Tint

The ceramic layer bounces heat back out and stops UV. Daylight still fills the room.

Will the film make my rooms dark?

No. Nano ceramic films block heat without heavy darkening. You choose the shade — from almost clear to full privacy.

Can you do a whole building?

Yes. We fit villas, offices, shops and full towers, and can work evenings, weekends or in phases.
